summary: End-to-end testing of Dazzle Dental MVP. All 9 backend pytest tests passed (root, services catalog, appointments CRUD with validation + _id leak check, contact with email validation). All critical frontend flows passed: landing page renders all sections, booking form end-to-end (name, phone, category Teeth, service, future date via shadcn Calendar popover, time slot, submit -> success state shown), contact form submission (toast 'Message sent — we'll reply within 24 hours' shown), sticky header backdrop-blur applied on scroll, WhatsApp floating button visible and links to wa.me with phone, mobile menu toggle opens the menu on 390px viewport showing nav links + Book Visit.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single file with both models and routes — fine at current size (~190 lines) but split into models.py + routers/ if more endpoints are added.

POST /api/appointments has no upper bound on preferred_date validity (any string accepted). Consider validating ISO date format and that date is not in the past on the backend (currently only enforced client-side via Calendar disabled prop).
AppointmentCreate.service is Optional and unvalidated against the /api/services catalog — clients can pass any string as service. Consider cross-validating against the static catalog.

CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers will reject credentialed requests with wildcard. Acceptable here since no credentialed requests are used, but tighten origins in production.
Frontend BookingForm and Contact rely on toasts (sonner) — confirmed working; no error-state UI for failed network/API calls beyond toast (no inline form-level error).
seed_data_creation: Test booking + test contact message were created via the live UI/API during testing (prefix TEST_ on backend pytest data).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All critical flows pass. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py — re-run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py -v. Note: mobile menu test must be done in isolation with viewport set BEFORE navigation; switching viewport mid-session can give false negatives for visibility checks.
